text:
Ravi Patel: Proposal: ship a compact OSS refapp launch aimed at engineers who want a runnable example + benchmark. 2-week runway.
Maya Chen: Sounds good. Key assets: 1) quickstart tutorial, 2) benchmark post + raw CSV, 3) 30min webinar + office hours, 4) promo kit (tweet thread, slack blurb, gif)
Lina Gomez: Audience should be platform engineers and app devs. Tone: technical and results-first. Drop the marketing fluff.
Noah Wright: For benchmarks, we'll compare default serving vs Redwood Optimize settings. Include cost-per-token and p95 latency across seq lengths. Add a reproducibility appendix.
Ravi Patel: Routing for signups: Netlify form -> Zapier -> HubSpot -> add tag refapp_oss -> slack alert to #sales-dev. Also create a GH discussion when someone signs up and includes a repo link.
Maya Chen: Promo cadence idea: Day0 repo + tutorial, Day3 benchmark blog, Day7 webinar. Email + community Slack + 2 social posts per asset.
Lina Gomez: Design checklist: hero image, benchmark graph (jpg + SVG), 10s looping GIF of local dev loop, and a 1:00 explainer clip. I'll do drafts by Wed. Design Bot: Drafts uploaded to Figma: https://figma.example.com/file/refapp-launch
Noah Wright: Example benchmark command to include in repo: 
```bash
python infra/bench.py --model redwood-small --concurrency 8 --sequence-lengths 64,256,1024 --out results.csv
```
Ravi Patel: Messaging snippets for dev channels: "Fork the refapp, run the quickstart, see how tuning cuts cost in half." Keep CTAs code-first.
Maya Chen: Webinar structure: 10m quickstart demo, 15m benchmark deep-dive, 20m live debugging / QA. Host: Maya + Noah. Offer clickable code snippets in the live demo.
Lina Gomez: For inbound lead handling, make sure UTM params are captured and HubSpot creates contacts with a custom property "refapp_interest" set to true. Noah: I can wire the webhook to Segment.
Noah Wright: Will add GH Action to run a smoke benchmark on PRs so contributors can't break the quickstart. Sample YAML in the repo.
Ravi Patel: Prize idea: $300 credit to three contributors who submit perf-improving PRs within 30 days of launch. We'll highlight winners in the follow-up post.
Maya Chen: KPIs to track: repo forks, benchmark CSV downloads, webinar signups, HubSpot MQLs. Lina, can you prepare hero + GIF by Wed?
Lina Gomez: Yes. Uploading now.
Design Bot: Hero and GIF uploaded to Figma and shared in this thread.
Marketing Bot: Weekly checklist reminder: finalize landing page copy, schedule webinar, set up HubSpot form by Tue 9am.
Ravi Patel: Assign owners: Maya -> webinar + copy, Noah -> infra + benchmarks, Lina -> design assets, Ravi -> routing + prize setup. Keep updates in this thread.
Maya Chen: Great. I'll spin up the GH project and assign tasks. Thanks all.
